# ArrivalConfig { #ambdes.ArrivalConfig }

```python
ArrivalConfig(arrival_csv)
```

Prepare arrival inputs for the simulation.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name                 | Type         | Description                                                            |
|----------------------|--------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| arrival_df           | pd.DataFrame | Mean arrival counts by day of week and response category.              |
| variation_df         | pd.DataFrame | Summary of variation in category proportions across days of the week.  |
| category_proportions | pd.Series    | Mean proportion of arrivals in each response category across the week. |
| nspp_df              | pd.DataFrame | Arrival schedule in the format required by `sim_tools` `NSPPThinning`. |
